loopHistory.summary: Restored a truthful canonical release Gate and implemented a shadow-only prospective signal ledger with immutable 1/3/5-session outcomes, sample-gated statistics, read-only API, Decision and Evidence integration, full deterministic/build/privacy/Chrome verification and an accepted independent NVIDIA review.
residualRisks: The ledger starts prospectively at feature activation and deliberately contains too few observations for rates until each horizon reaches 20 resolved trials.
A fixed 2% material-move threshold is a transparent first contract, not a claim that the same threshold is optimal across volatility regimes.

Resolved outcomes remain immutable for auditability, so later provider corrections are visible only in pending sessions and must be handled by a future explicit correction policy rather than silent rewrite.
Signal strength remains an evidence score with no trading authority; promotion would require substantially broader prospective history and regime-stratified validation.

Cross-market precursor strength is not a probability and lacks prospective lead-time, false-alert, coverage and regime-drift evidence.
Large compatibility surfaces and browser-global write paths should be reduced incrementally through existing seams, not by a high-risk rewrite.
The final roadmap is Host synthesis informed by verified external reviews; only the immutable sanitized input bundle itself has direct cross-provider lineage.
